title: FairCredit AI: Synthetic Data for Bias-Free Financial Inclusion
summary: FairCredit AI is a platform for generating fair synthetic financial/credit datasets that preserve legitimate risk signals while removing discriminatory bias, aimed at helping financial institutions build equitable credit models. Its core data generator imports CTGAN from SDV's tabular API to synthesize the fair training data.
